week.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
week.readme: AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications. Agents don't fit the request/response model. new.description: Agent skill for hill-climbing local LLM serving speed (decode, speculative decoding, prefill, KV, startup, TTFT) on any hardware and quantization
new.readme: An agent skill for hill-climbing the speed of a local LLM server on any hardware and any quantization. new.readme: Built by the team behind Dodaios, the open-source assistant that runs your coding agents for you. STE80 Humanizer makes AI-written text read like a careful person wrote it, without changing what it says. It combines two methods: The humanizer method. Remove the 26 tells from Wikipedia's Signs of AI writing, in the catalog of blader/humanizer. Karpathy's STE80 method. Rebuild the sentences "80% of the way to ASD-STE100", the controlled English of aircraft maintenance manuals.

items.title: Draft models trained on base weights may lose speed on harness-tuned adapters
items.connection: DSpine reports 2.3x to 3.2x throughput for Qwen3.8-27B agent replays, but today's pi LoRA changes that model's outputs, so the draft model's guesses may be accepted less often.
items.context: speculative decoding speed depends on how often the target accepts draft tokens
chain: Teams will want both the pi LoRA's quality and DSpine's throughput on the same server.
Speculative decoding only pays when the draft predicts what the target model would say, and the LoRA shifts those predictions.
If acceptance drops, the claimed speedup shrinks, and per-task serving cost rises quietly.
That creates a clear job: retrain or refresh the draft model on pi-LoRA traces, a service an inference team or vendor could sell.
items.who: Teams self-hosting coding agents on SGLang benefit; infra and platform budgets pay.
items.variable: serving cost per resolved agent task
items.versus: Measuring this before rollout beats discovering later that a stacked setup is slower than the numbers each part promised.
items.smallest_test: Replay 200 pi agent turns on SGLang with DSpine, with and without the LoRA; success for the risk hypothesis is LoRA throughput gain falling below 2.3x.
items.disconfirm: With the LoRA loaded, throughput gain stays within the reported 2.3x to 3.2x range.

items.connection: The pi LoRA reports a jump from 29.4% to 62.7% on one benchmark subset, Preference Model shows models can take shortcuts and fail to fully disclose them, and FrontierHarness Eval frames choices as model plus harness pairings.
